# Materials and Methods

```{r,echo=FALSE}
source('../../YieldDataModels/R/remove.harvest.outliers.fn.R')
source('../../YieldDataModels/R/remove.seed.outliers.fn.R')
source('../R/find.corners.R')

source('../R/find.neighborhood.R')
```

```{r}
harvest2019.dat <- read.csv(file='../data/B 2019 Soybean Harvest.csv')

```


```{r}
SwathWidth = 25.24

```

```{r}
source('../R/areal.yield.estimate.R')
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
library(mgcv)
if(!file.exists("ComparingYieldEstimatesB.Rda")) {
  seeding2018.dat$Y18 <- NA
  seeding2018.dat$Y17 <- NA
  
  seeding2020.dat$Y20 <- NA
  seeding2020.dat$Y19 <- NA
  
  rows <- dim(seeding2018.dat)[1]
  for(row in 1:rows) {
    current <- seeding2018.dat[row,]
    current <- add.corners(current)
    seeding2018.dat$Y17[row] <- areal.yield.estimate(current, harvest2017.dat, SwathWidth)
  } 
  rows <- dim(seeding2020.dat)[1]
  for(row in 1:rows) {
    current <- seeding2020.dat[row,]
    current <- add.corners(current)
    seeding2020.dat$Y19[row] <- areal.yield.estimate(current, harvest2019.dat, SwathWidth)
  }
  save(seeding2018.dat,seeding2020.dat, file="ComparingYieldEstimatesB.Rda")
} else {
  load(file="ComparingYieldEstimatesB.Rda")
}
```

## Determining smoothing of GAM fits

```{r}
corrmap <- data.frame(Rate = c(seeding2018.dat$ControlRate,
                               seeding2018.dat$AppliedRate,
                               seeding2020.dat$ControlRate,
                               seeding2020.dat$AppliedRate),
                      Yield = c(seeding2018.dat$Y17,
                                seeding2018.dat$Y17,
                                seeding2020.dat$Y19,
                                seeding2020.dat$Y19),
                      Measure = c(rep("Control Rate",length(seeding2018.dat$ControlRate)),
                                  rep("Applied Rate",length(seeding2018.dat$AppliedRate)),
                                  rep("Control Rate",length(seeding2020.dat$ControlRate)),
                                  rep("Applied Rate",length(seeding2020.dat$AppliedRate))),
                      Year = c(rep(2018,length(seeding2018.dat$ControlRate)),
                               rep(2018,length(seeding2018.dat$AppliedRate)),
                               rep(2020,length(seeding2020.dat$ControlRate)),
                               rep(2020,length(seeding2020.dat$AppliedRate)))
                      )
```

```{r,fig.width=8,fig.height=4}
corrmap$Year <- as.factor(corrmap$Year)
ggplot(corrmap, aes(Yield,Rate)) + 
geom_point(aes(colour = Year),size=1, alpha=0.3) + scale_colour_manual(values = cbPalette) +
labs(colour = "Year", x="Yield", y="Seeding Rate", title = "Relationship between prior year yield and seeding rate") + facet_wrap(~ Measure,nrow=4)
```

```{r}
kVec = 50 + (0:14)*20
base <- seeding2018.dat[,c("ControlRate","AppliedRate","Easting","Northing")]
base$K = 0
null.gam <- gam(Yield ~ 1, data=harvest2017.dat)
base$Yield <- predict(null.gam,newdata=base)
combined18 = base

base <- seeding2020.dat[,c("ControlRate","AppliedRate","Easting","Northing")]
base$K = 0
null.gam <- gam(Yield ~ 1, data=harvest2019.dat)
base$Yield <- predict(null.gam,newdata=base)
combined20 = base

plot.dat <- data.frame(K = rep(kVec, each=4))
plot.dat$Measure <- NA
plot.dat$Year <- NA
plot.dat$Value <- NA

idx = 1
for(k in kVec) {
  #2018 data
  current <- seeding2018.dat[,c("ControlRate", "AppliedRate","Easting","Northing")]
  current$K = k
  
  point.gam <- gam(Yield ~ s(Easting,Northing,k=k), data=harvest2017.dat)
  current$Yield <- predict(point.gam,newdata=current)
  combined18 = rbind(combined18, current)
  yield.gam <- gam(ControlRate ~ s(Yield), data=current)
  dev.explained <- 1- yield.gam$deviance/yield.gam$null.deviance
  plot.dat$Measure[idx] <- 'Control Rate'
  plot.dat$Value[idx] <- dev.explained*100
  plot.dat$Year[idx] <- 2018
  idx = idx+1

  cat(paste("Control Rate % explained", dev.explained,', k=',k,'\n'))
  yield.gam <- gam(AppliedRate ~ s(Yield), data=current)
  dev.explained <- 1- yield.gam$deviance/yield.gam$null.deviance
  #cat(paste("Applied Rate % explained", dev.explained,', k=',k,'\n'))
  plot.dat$Measure[idx] <- 'Applied Rate'
  plot.dat$Value[idx] <- dev.explained*100
  plot.dat$Year[idx] <- 2018
  idx = idx+1
    
  #2019 data
  current <- seeding2020.dat[,c("ControlRate", "AppliedRate","Easting","Northing")]
  current$K = k
  point.gam <- gam(Yield ~ s(Easting,Northing,k=k), data=harvest2019.dat)
  current$Yield <- predict(point.gam,newdata=current)
  combined20 = rbind(combined20, current)
  yield.gam <- gam(ControlRate ~ s(Yield), data=current)
  dev.explained <- 1- yield.gam$deviance/yield.gam$null.deviance
  plot.dat$Measure[idx] <- 'Control Rate'
  plot.dat$Value[idx] <- dev.explained*100
  plot.dat$Year[idx] <- 2020
  idx = idx+1
  
  cat(paste("Control Rate % explained", dev.explained,', k=',k,'\n'))
  yield.gam <- gam(AppliedRate ~ s(Yield), data=current)
  dev.explained <- 1- yield.gam$deviance/yield.gam$null.deviance
  #cat(paste("Applied Rate % explained", dev.explained,', k=',k,'\n'))
  plot.dat$Measure[idx] <- 'Applied Rate'
  plot.dat$Value[idx] <- dev.explained*100
  plot.dat$Year[idx] <- 2020
  idx = idx+1
}
```

```{r,fig.width=8,fig.height=4}
ggplot(plot.dat, aes(K,Value)) + 
geom_point(aes(colour = Measure),size=2) + scale_colour_manual(values = cbPalette) +
labs(colour = "Seeding Record", x="K (Smoothing Parameter)", y="Percent Explained", title = "Smoothing of Yield Maps Prior to Seeding") + facet_wrap(~ Year,nrow=1)
```

```{r,fig.width=8,fig.height=8}
ggplot(combined18, aes(Easting,Northing)) + 
geom_point(aes(colour = Yield),size=2) + 
scale_colour_gradient2(low=vermillion, mid=yellow, high=blue, midpoint = median(combined18$Yield)) +
labs(colour = "Relative Rank", x="Easting", y="Northing", title = "2018 Yield Mapped to Seeding, Decreasing Smoothness") + facet_wrap(~ K,nrow=4)
```


```{r,fig.width=8,fig.height=8}
ggplot(combined20, aes(Easting,Northing)) + 
geom_point(aes(colour = Yield),size=2) + 
scale_colour_gradient2(low=vermillion, mid=yellow, high=blue, midpoint = median(combined20$Yield)) +
```

## Visual comparison of yield prediction.

```{r}
point.gam <- gam(Yield ~ s(Easting,Northing,k=300), data=harvest2018.dat)
seeding2018.dat$PY18 <- predict(point.gam,newdata=seeding2018.dat)
  
point.gam <- gam(Yield ~ s(Easting,Northing,k=300), data=harvest2017.dat)
seeding2018.dat$PY17 <- predict(point.gam,newdata=seeding2018.dat)

point.gam <- gam(Yield ~ s(Easting,Northing,k=300), data=harvest2019.dat)
seeding2020.dat$PY19 <- predict(point.gam,newdata=seeding2020.dat)
  
point.gam <- gam(Yield ~ s(Easting,Northing,k=300), data=harvest2020.dat)
seeding2020.dat$PY20 <- predict(point.gam,newdata=seeding2020.dat)

seeding2020.dat$AR20 <- seeding2020.dat$AppliedRate
```

```{r}
harvest2017.dat$YieldRank <- rank(harvest2017.dat$Yield)
harvest2017.dat$YieldRank <- harvest2017.dat$YieldRank/max(harvest2017.dat$YieldRank)
seeding2018.dat$Y17Rank <- rank(seeding2018.dat$Y17)
seeding2018.dat$Y17Rank <- seeding2018.dat$Y17Rank/max(seeding2018.dat$Y17Rank)
seeding2018.dat$RateRank <- rank(seeding2018.dat$AppliedRate)
seeding2018.dat$RateRank <- seeding2018.dat$RateRank/max(seeding2018.dat$RateRank)
```

```{r}
seeding2018.dat$PRank <- rank(seeding2018.dat$PY18)
seeding2018.dat$PRank <- seeding2018.dat$PRank/max(seeding2018.dat$PRank)
```


```{r,echo=FALSE}
#convert yield values to ranks for plotting

seeding2020.dat$Y19Rank <- rank(seeding2020.dat$Y19)
seeding2020.dat$Y19Rank <- seeding2020.dat$Y19Rank/max(seeding2020.dat$Y19Rank)
seeding2020.dat$RateRank <- rank(seeding2020.dat$AppliedRate)
seeding2020.dat$RateRank <- seeding2020.dat$RateRank/max(seeding2020.dat$RateRank)

harvest2019.dat$YieldRank <- rank(harvest2019.dat$Yield)
harvest2019.dat$YieldRank <- harvest2019.dat$YieldRank/max(harvest2019.dat$YieldRank)
seeding2020.dat$PY19Rank <- rank(seeding2020.dat$PY19)
seeding2020.dat$PY19Rank <- seeding2020.dat$PY19Rank/max(seeding2020.dat$PY19Rank)
```

# Results

```{r,fig.width=6,fig.height=6}
Maps18 <- data.frame(Easting=c(harvest2017.dat$Easting, seeding2018.dat$Easting, seeding2018.dat$Easting, seeding2018.dat$Easting),
                   Northing=c(harvest2017.dat$Northing, seeding2018.dat$Northing,seeding2018.dat$Northing,seeding2018.dat$Northing),
                   Value=c(harvest2017.dat$YieldRank, seeding2018.dat$Y17Rank,seeding2018.dat$PRank,seeding2018.dat$RateRank),
                   Map=c(rep('Yield 2017 (Raw Ranks)',length(harvest2017.dat$YieldRank)),
                          rep('Yield 2017 (Seeding Grid)',length(seeding2018.dat$Y17Rank)),
                         rep('Yield 2017 (Point Estimate)',length(seeding2018.dat$PRank)),
                         rep('Seeding 2018',length(seeding2018.dat$RateRank))))
ggplot(Maps18, aes(Easting,Northing)) + 
geom_point(aes(colour = Value),size=0.5) + 
scale_colour_gradient2(low=vermillion, mid=yellow, high=blue, midpoint = 0.5) +
labs(colour = "Relative Rank", x="Easting", y="Northing", title = "Yield and Seeding Maps") + facet_wrap(~ Map,nrow=2)
```
